title: fix(E1700): stop rejecting rule names CloudFormation accepts

files.patch:
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 import cfnlint.data.schemas.other.rules
 from cfnlint.jsonschema import Validator
 from cfnlint.jsonschema._keywords import patternProperties
-from cfnlint.jsonschema._keywords_cfn import cfn_type
+from cfnlint.jsonschema._keywords_cfn import additionalProperties, cfn_type
 from cfnlint.rules.jsonschema.CfnLintJsonSchema import CfnLintJsonSchema, SchemaDetails
 
 
@@ -31,9 +31,21 @@ def __init__(self):
         )
         self.validators = {
             "type": cfn_type,
+            "additionalProperties": self._additional_properties,
             "patternProperties": self._pattern_properties,
         }
 
+    def _additional_properties(
+        self, validator: Validator, aP: Any, instance: Any, schema: Any
+    ):
+        # re-add the keyword so nested functions are still validated
+        validator = validator.evolve(
+            function_filter=validator.function_filter.evolve(
+                add_cfn_lint_keyword=True,
+            )
+        )
+        yield from additionalProperties(validator, aP, instance, schema)
+
     def _pattern_properties(
         self, validator: Validator, aP: Any, instance: Any, schema: Any
     ):

@@ -93,3 +102,81 @@ def test_validate(name, instance, expected, rule, validator):
     errs = list(rule.validate(validator, {}, instance, {}))
 
     assert errs == expected, f"Test {name!r} got {errs!r}"
+
+
+_NESTED_IDS = ("E1020", "E1700", "E1701", "E8003", "W8003")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name,rules,expected",
+    [
+        (
+            "Rule name CloudFormation accepts",
+            {
+                "Env_Check": {
+                    "Assertions": [{"Assert": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Env"}, "a"]}}]
+                }
+            },
+            [],
+        ),
+        (
+            "Fn::Equals with too many arguments",
+            {
+                "Rule1": {
+                    "Assertions": [
+                        {"Assert": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Env"}, "a", "b"]}}
+                    ]
+                }
+            },
+            ["E8003"],
+        ),
+        (
+            "Ref to a parameter that doesn't exist in an assertion",
+            {
+                "Rule1": {
+                    "Assertions": [
+                        {"Assert": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Missing"}, "a"]}}
+                    ]
+                }
+            },
+            ["E1020"],
+        ),
+        (
+            "Ref to a parameter that doesn't exist in a rule condition",
+            {
+                "Rule1": {
+                    "RuleCondition": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Missing"}, "a"]},
+                    "Assertions": [{"Assert": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Env"}, "a"]}}],
+                }
+            },
+            ["E1020"],
+        ),
+        (
+            "Fn::GetAtt is not supported in an assertion",
+            {"Rule1": {"Assertions": [{"Assert": {"Fn::GetAtt": ["Topic", "Arn"]}}]}},
+            ["E1701"],
+        ),
+        (
+            "Rule condition that always returns the same result",
+            {
+                "Rule1": {
+                    "RuleCondition": {"Fn::Equals": ["a", "a"]},
+                    "Assertions": [{"Assert": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Env"}, "b"]}}],
+                }
+            },
+            ["W8003"],
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_nested_functions(name, rules, expected):
+    # a full lint, so the function filter inside Rules is exercised
+    template = {
+        "Parameters": {"Env": {"Type": "String"}},
+        "Rules": rules,
+        "Resources": {"Topic": {"Type": "AWS::SNS::Topic"}},
+    }
+
+    matches = lint(json.dumps(template), regions=["us-east-1"])
+    ids = sorted(match.rule.id for match in matches if match.rule.id in _NESTED_IDS)
+
+    assert ids == expected, f"Test {name!r} got {matches!r}"
